reactions.label: Ready
reactions.alt: Gertrude, a dark-gray raccoon woman with a red asymmetrical bob, smiling gently and ready for her date

reactions.label: Determined
reactions.alt: Gertrude squares her shoulders with a confident grin and a small ready-to-go fist

reactions.label: Delighted
reactions.alt: Gertrude beams with bright eyes, perked ears, and both hands raised in delight

reactions.label: Skeptical
reactions.alt: Gertrude folds her arms and gives an unimpressed sideways look with one eyebrow raised

reactions.label: Worried
reactions.alt: Gertrude draws inward with softened downcast eyes, one hand at her chest and the other holding her sleeve

reactions.label: Tender
reactions.alt: Gertrude smiles warmly with softened eyes and one hand resting over her heart
